queries: SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS excess_over_overall FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS overall_avg FROM station_avg) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandwidth_usage, s.avg_bandwidth_usage - o.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bandwidth_usage > o.overall_avg ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of bandusagepct over all telescope rows with a non-null value, so stations with more telescopes weigh more. Only stations that have at least one telescope with a non-null value are considered.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean of the per-station averages, so each station counts equally regardless of how many telescopes it has.

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of bandusagepct across all telescope rows (each telescope weighted equally), not the mean of the per-station averages.
Stations are taken from the telescopes table's observstation column; stations with no telescopes or only NULL bandwidth values are excluded.
